correctness.rationale: All k-monitor layouts on a star reduce by leaf automorphisms to hub-included or leaf-only. A uniform single seed yields exact conditional mixtures of a zero atom, Exp(alpha), Exp(k beta), and independent sums. The exact signed survival difference is ((m-k+1)alpha-k beta)/(m+1) times the strictly positive convolution integral of the two exponential kernels, including equal rates. This establishes all-time strict stochastic dominance or equality of full laws, the exact budget threshold, and all boundary cases m>=1 and 1<=k<=m. The independent full-state CTMC Laplace checker passed 6048 exact and numerical diagnostic assertions; finite checks were not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: An exact all-time stochastic-order optimum resolves every increasing detection-delay penalty in a natural early-warning network motif, for all finite monitor budgets and all positive oriented transmission rates. The result exposes a hub-exclusion transition as the monitoring budget grows, even with symmetric rates, and a nontrivial equality of entire distributions at the exact threshold. This is a structural complete classification with an operationally interpretable motivation, not an arbitrary isolated numerical fact. Its scope and non-exponential failure boundary are stated explicitly; applicability to real networks is not claimed.
